+import unittest
+
+from durations import parse_duration
+
+
+class ParseDurationTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_converts_each_supported_unit_to_milliseconds(self):
+        for text, expected in (
+            ("250ms", 250),
+            ("3s", 3000),
+            ("2m", 120_000),
+            ("2h", 7_200_000),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(text=text):
+                self.assertEqual(parse_duration(text), expected)
+
+    def test_accepts_smallest_positive_value_in_each_unit(self):
+        for text, expected in (
+            ("1ms", 1),
+            ("1s", 1000),
+            ("1m", 60_000),
+            ("1h", 3_600_000),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(text=text):
+                self.assertEqual(parse_duration(text), expected)
+
+    def test_strips_surrounding_whitespace(self):
+        self.assertEqual(parse_duration(" \t\n3s\r\n "), 3000)
+
+    def test_accepts_leading_zeros_for_positive_values(self):
+        self.assertEqual(parse_duration("0002m"), 120_000)
+
+    def test_preserves_large_integer_precision(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            parse_duration("9007199254740993h"),
+            9007199254740993 * 3_600_000,
+        )
+
+    def test_rejects_non_strings_with_type_error(self):
+        for value in (None, True, 1, 1.5, b"1s", [], {}):
+            with self.subTest(value=value):
+                with self.assertRaises(TypeError) as raised:
+                    parse_duration(value)
+                self.assertEqual(str(raised.exception), "duration must be a string")
+
+    def test_rejects_invalid_formats_with_value_error(self):
+        for text in (
+            "", " \t\n", "1", "s", "-1s", "+1s", "1.5s",
+            "1 s", "1\ns", "1S", "1d", "1msec", "x1s", "1sx",
+            "1s2m", "1s\nextra",
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(text=text):
+                with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as raised:
+                    parse_duration(text)
+                self.assertEqual(str(raised.exception), f"invalid duration: {text!r}")
+
+    def test_rejects_zero_in_each_unit_including_padded_zero(self):
+        for text in ("0ms", "0s", "0m", "0h", "000ms", " \t00s\n"):
+            with self.subTest(text=text):
+                with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as raised:
+                    parse_duration(text)
+                self.assertEqual(str(raised.exception), "duration must be positive")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
